name: Deore LX thumb-shifter pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed complete left/right SL-M453-A thumb-shifter pair, without brake levers; 7-speed SIS with SIS/friction mode switch, 22.2 mm handlebar clamps. The 1991 manual explicitly identifies the 184 g figure as a pair.
